kills.measured: opponent 0.0 -> 0.2, chosen by scripts/dev/search_weights_by_outcome.py against OUTCOMES rather than MAE: 3 chronological folds, point-in-time replay of 836 graded props, adopted on fold majority. Held-out log-loss 0.7243 -> 0.7208 and prediction MAE 5.34 -> 5.30, so it improves both objectives. The MAE search had pinned opponent at 0.0 because an opponent adjustment spreads projections apart, which costs absolute error while helping ranking. shrink 4 -> 12 was also found and NOT taken: it cuts the between-player spread the floor test protects, and over-confidence belongs in the residual scale.
